replies.Do you ever get anxious when thinking ab: Yes, I often feel anxious when faced with complex math problems, especially in exams or when time is limited. My high neuroticism makes me more sensitive to stress. I try to calm myself with deep breathing or yoga, which helps me focus. It’s not a fear of math itself, but the pressure of not knowing the right steps or making mistakes.
replies.Did you ever use AI to support your math: Yes, I used AI tools like ChatGPT to clarify concepts in calculus and linear algebra. However, I sometimes felt dependent on it and worried about not developing my own problem-solving skills.
